mira: FYI brought up a hybrid convert (llama->gemma->qwen) for 'bridgehead-lite' and seeing weird off-by-one numerics + sentinel tokens leaking into summaries. not huge perf hit but reproducible on our small smoke.

mira: reproducer: `python eval.py --model /mnt/models/bridgehead-lite-qwen/ --task summarization --quant int4`

devon: any tokenizer diffs? sentinel/pad handling can get lost when multi-step conversion does not lock specials.

mira: quick token check: upstream BOS=1 EOS=2 PAD=0 preserved, but some internal sentinels (e.g., <sent_42>) moved by +2. also see strange embedding drift for leading tokens.

zhen: that suggests converter did a partial remap after first hop (llama->gemma) and then another shift when gemma->qwen ran. double-shifts + rotary per-head freq mismatch can misalign KV cache sin/cos indexing.

eva: can you paste a tiny model-load log?

mira: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-22T09:04:10Z] convert: llama->gemma applied shift=+2 (preserve_specials=True)
[2026-03-22T09:04:12Z] convert: gemma->qwen applied shift=-1 (preserve_specials=False)
[2026-03-22T09:04:12Z] loader: rotary_head_scale=True; rotary_freq_norm diff=0.0008
[2026-03-22T09:04:13Z] eval: rougeL 0.412 -> 0.389
```

devon: ok two issues: 1) inconsistent preserve_specials across hops, 2) tiny rotary freq norm diff. both together can surface as sentinel bleed or misdecoded numerics.

zhen: mitigation: enforce preserve_specials on every conversion hop, and add a conversion-time invariant check that computes token-id diffs for top-100 tokens and accumulates per-head rotary freq L2 norm. if a model experiences both a non-zero token shift and rotary-norm>threshold, fail the conversion.

eva: also add a loader warning if a converted artifact has rotary_head_scale=True. converted models should default to head_scale off unless manually validated.

convert-bot: Auto-check: token-id-diff=24 for top-100 tokens; rotary_freq_norm=0.0008; artifact quarantined.

mira: reconvert with preserve_specials=true across both hops and force rotary_head_scale=false at load time — quick smoke recovered rougeL to 0.408 (close). will run full eval after PR.

zhen: I'll open PR to add hop-aware preserve_specials enforcement + token/rotary smoke test. add unit tests for multi-hop conversions.

eva: updating model-catalog: quarantine flag set, owners notified.

triage-bot: Filed INFR-621 "multi-hop conversion: sentinel/token shift + rotary-norm smoke" linking to INFR-214 and INFR-336.

mira: thanks; small footnote — watch for sentinel tokens leaking into outputs even if perplexities look fine. they often indicate index misalignments. :eyes:
